title: The new-feature flow: a requirement scored, the graph told about it, and the builder shown the blast radius BEFORE the code changes

steps.claim: the run was governed before it changed anything — the contract was active before the first write, not declared after the fact
readiness was established before the work started — a DoR that passed, ahead of the first write
the definition of done was checked before anything claimed the work was finished
steps.reason: the build evaluation stops at design approval; implementation DoD is downstream of the human-approved Design Contract

steps.claim: the new-feature flow dispatched product and design roles through the host instead of executing them inline
the Design Contract's proposed graph and contracts passed the mechanical design gate before human approval
nothing expensive was derived twice — the diff, the blast radius and the graph scan were each computed once and shared
steps.reason: the build flow stops at design approval before implementation derives a diff or shared review envelope; the design graph is evaluated separately by B2
